en: Illustrated satirical postcard printed in German, depicting a caricature of a worried, big‑headed man (identified as Mr. Chamberlain) sitting on a chair, holding and reading several telegrams labeled "TELEGRAMM" with a distressed expression and his hand on his forehead. The title at the top mentions the Boer War and Chamberlain receiving telegrams from the theater of war. A humorous rhyming caption is printed beneath the figure. Decorative corner mounts are visible around the image.
